items.q: attrition mill may be defined as
o: the size of the feed divided by the size of the product of a mill
a mill that breaks material by rubbing it between two surfaces
a mill in which free swinging hammers beat the material against a screen
the perforated plate that holds material in the grinding zone until it is fine enough to pass
items.s: attrition mill: a mill that breaks material by rubbing it between two surfaces. The other options describe screen in a mill, hammer mill, size reduction ratio.

items.q: In this course, shelling refers to
o: the mass of produce a machine handles in unit time
the stripping of the outer coat from a seed or groundnut kernel
the gap between the working parts of a sheller or thresher
the removal of the hard outer covering from a nut or grain

items.q: The correct meaning of evaporation is

water held in a material in excess of the amount that balances the surrounding air
the mass of moisture removed from a material on unit area in unit time
the removal of moisture from a material by evaporation
items.s: evaporation: the change of water into vapour at a temperature below its boiling point. The other options describe free moisture, drying rate, drying.

the stage of drying in which water evaporates from the surface as fast as it arrives there
the stage of drying in which the surface begins to dry and the rate of evaporation slows
water held in a material in excess of the amount that balances the surrounding air
items.s: constant rate period: the stage of drying in which water evaporates from the surface as fast as it arrives there. The other options describe free moisture, deep bed drying, falling rate period.

items.q: “the reduction of material to a fine powder” is the definition of
o: grinding
crushing
comminution
hardgrove grindability

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains latent heat of vaporisation.
o: the heat needed to turn unit mass of water into vapour at the same temperature
heat that changes the temperature of a substance without changing its state
material of low thermal conductivity wrapped round a vessel to slow the loss of heat
the share of the heat released by the fuel that is taken up by the water and steam

items.t: Process energy, steam and heat transfer

items.q: The correct meaning of insulation is
o: a device in which heat passes from a hot fluid to a cold one without the two mixing
material of low thermal conductivity wrapped round a vessel to slow the loss of heat
the share of the heat released by the fuel that is taken up by the water and steam
heat that changes the temperature of a substance without changing its state
items.s: insulation: material of low thermal conductivity wrapped round a vessel to slow the loss of heat. The other options describe boiler efficiency, sensible heat, heat exchanger.
items.t: Process energy, steam and heat transfer

items.q: The correct meaning of oil yield is
o: the pressing of oil out of prepared seed by mechanical force
the mass of oil recovered from a stated mass of seed
the dissolving of oil out of seed by washing it with a liquid solvent
an acid formed when a fat splits, used as a measure of the quality of an oil
items.s: oil yield: the mass of oil recovered from a stated mass of seed. The other options describe expression, free fatty acid, solvent extraction.

items.q: “the mass of a loose granular material divided by the volume it occupies when poured into a container” is the definition of
o: hardness
moisture content dry basis
true density
bulk density
items.s: bulk density is the mass of a loose granular material divided by the volume it occupies when poured into a container.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains fixed cost.
o: an expense of the plant that does not change with the quantity processed
a secondary material of value obtained alongside the main product of a process
the statement that the mass entering a process equals the mass leaving it plus what accumulates
the total cost of a process divided by the mass of product turned out
items.s: fixed cost: an expense of the plant that does not change with the quantity processed. The other options describe unit processing cost, material balance, by product.

items.q: “the fraction by mass of a steam sample that is vapour rather than suspended droplets” is the definition of
o: boiler efficiency
sensible heat
latent heat of vaporisation
steam quality
items.s: steam quality is the fraction by mass of a steam sample that is vapour rather than suspended droplets.
items.t: Process energy, steam and heat transfer

items.q: The correct meaning of free fatty acid is
o: an acid formed when a fat splits, used as a measure of the quality of an oil
the share of the oil present in the seed that the process actually recovers
the dissolving of oil out of seed by washing it with a liquid solvent
the solid residue left after oil has been pressed from seed
items.s: free fatty acid: an acid formed when a fat splits, used as a measure of the quality of an oil. The other options describe extraction efficiency, solvent extraction, cake.

items.q: The correct meaning of terminal velocity is
o: a measure of how closely the shape of a particle approaches a sphere
the mass of a material divided by the volume of its solid matter alone, with all pores excluded
the mass of a loose granular material divided by the volume it occupies when poured into a container
the steady speed reached by a particle falling through air when drag balances its weight
items.s: terminal velocity: the steady speed reached by a particle falling through air when drag balances its weight. The other options describe sphericity, bulk density, true density.

items.q: roller mill may be defined as
o: the perforated plate that holds material in the grinding zone until it is fine enough to pass
a mill that crushes grain between pairs of smooth or fluted rollers
the size of the feed divided by the size of the product of a mill
a mill in which free swinging hammers beat the material against a screen
items.s: roller mill: a mill that crushes grain between pairs of smooth or fluted rollers. The other options describe size reduction ratio, hammer mill, screen in a mill.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines aspiration?
o: kernels that have been cracked or split during handling or processing
the sorting of particles by the density difference between them
the lifting away of light impurities from a falling stream of produce by suction
the sorting of produce into lots of uniform size, shape or quality
items.s: aspiration: the lifting away of light impurities from a falling stream of produce by suction. The other options describe specific gravity separation, grading, broken grain.

items.q: The correct meaning of hygroscopic material is
o: the steady speed reached by a particle falling through air when drag balances its weight
a substance that takes up or gives off moisture until it is in balance with the surrounding air
the mass of a material divided by the volume of its solid matter alone, with all pores excluded
the mass of a loose granular material divided by the volume it occupies when poured into a container
items.s: hygroscopic material: a substance that takes up or gives off moisture until it is in balance with the surrounding air. The other options describe terminal velocity, true density, bulk density.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains throughput.
o: the proportion of the seed present in a lot that is successfully freed from its shell
the loosening of grain from the ear by beating or rubbing
injury to the living embryo of a seed caused by rough handling or overheating
the mass of produce a machine handles in unit time
items.s: throughput: the mass of produce a machine handles in unit time. The other options describe threshing, germination damage, shelling efficiency.

items.q: In this course, equilibrium moisture content refers to
o: the moisture a material settles at when it is in balance with the air around it
the drying of a layer of grain so thick that the air changes conditions as it passes through
the removal of moisture from a material by evaporation
the change of water into vapour at a temperature below its boiling point
items.s: equilibrium moisture content: the moisture a material settles at when it is in balance with the air around it. The other options describe drying, deep bed drying, evaporation.

items.q: The correct meaning of sensible heat is
o: heat that changes the temperature of a substance without changing its state
the heat needed to raise the temperature of unit mass of a substance by one degree
the heat liberated when unit mass of a fuel is completely burned
the heat needed to turn unit mass of water into vapour at the same temperature
items.s: sensible heat: heat that changes the temperature of a substance without changing its state. The other options describe latent heat of vaporisation, specific heat, calorific value.
items.t: Process energy, steam and heat transfer

items.q: In this course, hardgrove grindability refers to
o: material whose particles are so small that its surface area is very large for its mass
an index of how easily a material can be ground to a stated fineness
the reduction of large lumps to coarse pieces by compressive force
a mill that crushes grain between pairs of smooth or fluted rollers
items.s: hardgrove grindability: an index of how easily a material can be ground to a stated fineness. The other options describe finely divided product, roller mill, crushing.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the keeping of produce in a sealed container in which the air is not renewed”
o: respiration
hermetic storage
airflow rate
hot spot
items.s: hermetic storage is the keeping of produce in a sealed container in which the air is not renewed.

items.q: In this course, extraction efficiency refers to
o: the dissolving of oil out of seed by washing it with a liquid solvent
the share of the oil present in the seed that the process actually recovers
the proportion of oil held in a seed on a stated basis
the treatment of crude oil to remove gums, free fatty acids and colouring matter
items.s: extraction efficiency: the share of the oil present in the seed that the process actually recovers. The other options describe oil content, solvent extraction, refining.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains extraction efficiency.
o: the share of the oil present in the seed that the process actually recovers
an acid formed when a fat splits, used as a measure of the quality of an oil
a screw press that squeezes oil from seed and pushes out a pressed cake
the mass of oil recovered from a stated mass of seed
items.s: extraction efficiency: the share of the oil present in the seed that the process actually recovers. The other options describe free fatty acid, oil yield, expeller.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “damage to stored produce caused by the growth of fungi”
o: chilling injury
airflow rate
mould spoilage
silo
items.s: mould spoilage is damage to stored produce caused by the growth of fungi.

items.q: “the removal of the hard outer covering from a nut or grain” is the definition of
o: throughput
shelling
shelling efficiency
clearance
items.s: shelling is the removal of the hard outer covering from a nut or grain.

items.q: The correct meaning of oil content is
o: an acid formed when a fat splits, used as a measure of the quality of an oil
a screw press that squeezes oil from seed and pushes out a pressed cake
the solid residue left after oil has been pressed from seed
the proportion of oil held in a seed on a stated basis
items.s: oil content: the proportion of oil held in a seed on a stated basis. The other options describe cake, expeller, free fatty acid.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains hammer mill.
o: the breaking of solid material into smaller pieces by applied force
an index of how easily a material can be ground to a stated fineness
a mill that crushes grain between pairs of smooth or fluted rollers
a mill in which free swinging hammers beat the material against a screen
items.s: hammer mill: a mill in which free swinging hammers beat the material against a screen. The other options describe roller mill, comminution, hardgrove grindability.

items.q: The correct meaning of bulk density is
o: the steady speed reached by a particle falling through air when drag balances its weight
the steepest angle to the horizontal that a heap of the material will stand at without sliding
the resistance a grain offers to being crushed or penetrated
the mass of a loose granular material divided by the volume it occupies when poured into a container
items.s: bulk density: the mass of a loose granular material divided by the volume it occupies when poured into a container. The other options describe terminal velocity, angle of repose, hardness.

items.q: inclination limit may be defined as
o: a conveyor in which cups fixed to a vertical belt or chain lift material upward
the angle the surface of material heaped on a moving belt makes with the horizontal
a conveyor in which an endless moving band carries the material
the steepest slope at which a belt conveyor can carry a given material without it rolling back
items.s: inclination limit: the steepest slope at which a belt conveyor can carry a given material without it rolling back. The other options describe bucket elevator, surcharge angle, belt conveyor.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains terminal velocity.
o: the steady speed reached by a particle falling through air when drag balances its weight
the mass of water in a material expressed as a percentage of the mass of its dry matter
the mass of a loose granular material divided by the volume it occupies when poured into a container
the steepest angle to the horizontal that a heap of the material will stand at without sliding
items.s: terminal velocity: the steady speed reached by a particle falling through air when drag balances its weight. The other options describe angle of repose, moisture content dry basis, bulk density.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains roller mill.
o: an index of how easily a material can be ground to a stated fineness
the breaking of solid material into smaller pieces by applied force
the reduction of large lumps to coarse pieces by compressive force
a mill that crushes grain between pairs of smooth or fluted rollers
items.s: roller mill: a mill that crushes grain between pairs of smooth or fluted rollers. The other options describe hardgrove grindability, comminution, crushing.

items.q: Three of these relate to Threshing, shelling and decortication. Which one does not?
o: shelling
material balance
threshing
decortication
items.s: Every other option belongs to Threshing, shelling and decortication. “material balance” belongs to Process economics and product yield, not Threshing, shelling and decortication.

items.q: The correct meaning of extraction efficiency is
o: the mass of oil recovered from a stated mass of seed
the treatment of crude oil to remove gums, free fatty acids and colouring matter
a screw press that squeezes oil from seed and pushes out a pressed cake
the share of the oil present in the seed that the process actually recovers
items.s: extraction efficiency: the share of the oil present in the seed that the process actually recovers. The other options describe expeller, oil yield, refining.

items.q: “the drying of a layer of grain so thick that the air changes conditions as it passes through” is the definition of
o: thin layer drying
free moisture
drying
deep bed drying
items.s: deep bed drying is the drying of a layer of grain so thick that the air changes conditions as it passes through.

items.q: In this course, size reduction ratio refers to
o: the size of the feed divided by the size of the product of a mill
the perforated plate that holds material in the grinding zone until it is fine enough to pass
material whose particles are so small that its surface area is very large for its mass
a mill that breaks material by rubbing it between two surfaces
items.s: size reduction ratio: the size of the feed divided by the size of the product of a mill. The other options describe screen in a mill, finely divided product, attrition mill.

items.q: finely divided product may be defined as
o: the perforated plate that holds material in the grinding zone until it is fine enough to pass
material whose particles are so small that its surface area is very large for its mass
an index of how easily a material can be ground to a stated fineness
the breaking of solid material into smaller pieces by applied force
items.s: finely divided product: material whose particles are so small that its surface area is very large for its mass. The other options describe screen in a mill, comminution, hardgrove grindability.

items.q: “the mass of water in a material expressed as a percentage of the mass of its dry matter” is the definition of
o: moisture content dry basis
true density
moisture content wet basis
hygroscopic material
items.s: moisture content dry basis is the mass of water in a material expressed as a percentage of the mass of its dry matter.

items.q: The correct meaning of airflow rate is
o: damage to produce caused by holding it below the temperature it can tolerate
the volume of air passed through a bulk of produce for each unit of its mass in unit time
the breathing of living produce that uses up oxygen and releases heat and moisture
the killing of insects in stored produce by exposing them to a poisonous gas
items.s: airflow rate: the volume of air passed through a bulk of produce for each unit of its mass in unit time. The other options describe fumigation, respiration, chilling injury.

items.q: In this course, bound moisture refers to
o: the drying of a sample shallow enough that the air conditions are the same throughout it
the mass of moisture removed from a material on unit area in unit time
the stage of drying in which water evaporates from the surface as fast as it arrives there
water held within the structure of a material so tightly that it exerts a reduced vapour pressure
items.s: bound moisture: water held within the structure of a material so tightly that it exerts a reduced vapour pressure. The other options describe constant rate period, drying rate, thin layer drying.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the gap between the working parts of a sheller or thresher”
o: throughput
germination damage
clearance
moisture for shelling
items.s: clearance is the gap between the working parts of a sheller or thresher.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines conveyor capacity?
o: a conveyor in which a turning helical flight pushes material along a trough
the angle the surface of material heaped on a moving belt makes with the horizontal
a conveyor in which material is carried along a pipe by a stream of air
the mass or volume of material a conveyor moves in unit time
items.s: conveyor capacity: the mass or volume of material a conveyor moves in unit time. The other options describe screw conveyor, surcharge angle, pneumatic conveyor.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines falling rate period?
o: the stage of drying in which water evaporates from the surface as fast as it arrives there
the stage of drying in which the surface begins to dry and the rate of evaporation slows
the removal of moisture from a material by evaporation
water held in a material in excess of the amount that balances the surrounding air
items.s: falling rate period: the stage of drying in which the surface begins to dry and the rate of evaporation slows. The other options describe constant rate period, free moisture, drying.
